title: qa(checklist): re-point stale studio-authoring, records-forms and attachments-storage items to the product
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQTfJ3xVbcN2bQP4yPftVjU)_

Fixes #33329

Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：重新指向 studio-authoring、records-forms、attachments-storage 三个清单区域中 33 个过期测试项（另含 #33331 转来的 qa-scratch-authz 配方一行），每项 revision +1 并追加一条 history。
- 为什么改：#32908 扫描记录这些项的步骤、标签或验收文字已与产品不符（批次 B）；逐行在当前 main 上按源码复核后才改。
- 风险与回滚：只改三个清单 JSON，无产品代码、无脚本；回滚即 revert 本提交。
- 先看：下方逐行表格，每行写明处置与 main 上的源码位置（文件:行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist` 退出 0；抽查表格任一行的证据位置。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地

## What changes

Batch B of the #32908 re-point sweep. Every row on the card was re-measured on `main` at `87330e89` by reading the source named in the table; none was driven live. Each re-pointed item gets one `revision` bump and one `history` row (`ref: "#33329"`, date 2026-11-14) that names the QA record and comment it came from. Row 202 came from #33331 (batch E) and edits the `qa-scratch-authz` recipe, which carries no revision/history, so its provenance sentence records the change instead.

Only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{studio-authoring,records-forms,attachments-storage}.json` change (+315 / −114). The files were edited at the text level and each edit was proved by re-parsing the whole file and comparing it with the expected document, so untouched items are byte-identical.

## Tests

Checklist text only; no product code or test changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 0, and every gate `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff exits 0 (16 of 16, reconciled with `--ran`). `pnpm lint` scoped to touched packages: none touched (docs-only diff), so not applicable.

## Acceptance notes

- **No `needs_decision` rows and no row left for a live drive.** Two rows were narrowed rather than guessed. Row 38: the source confirms the default record page lists header actions by id, but which fixture shape QA should use was never driven, so the item gains a knownGaps line instead of a rewritten fixture body. Row 125: the claim that the flow identifier derives without the namespace is not settled by source reading, so it was not added; the rest of the row is re-pointed.
- Rows 29 and 216 are the same item, so they share one revision bump and one history row.
- Row 202 is a recipe (no revision/history fields); its provenance sentence carries the #33329 note.
